svg.title: Resources created by workshop Cloud setup
svg.desc: The setup script creates a Managed Postgres instance, a six-table Postgres CDC ClickPipe, and a one-replica ClickHouse Cloud service. It configures source roles and a publication, pricing and otel databases, CDC destination tables and canonical views, and a read-only agent role. It saves endpoints and credentials, resource IDs, and the TLS CA certificate privately on the learner laptop.

text.tspan: AWS · Singapore by default · dedicated to your workshop
Ready for the telemetry collector later
Next: load history, build aggregates, and start sales. Create your managed agent in Module 05.
